note: ⛔ SNG-489. THE FIVE SCHOOLS OF BODY. As with Mind, a school is WHAT A CRAFT DOES, not which sect it descends from — and Body's schools cross the somatic/mason line in four of five cases.

Conditioning._what: ⛔ THE BODY MADE MORE DURABLE, MORE PRECISE, OR MORE STEADY — including someone else's.
Conditioning._note: ⚠️ All somatic. The one pure-sect school, and the tradition's identity.

Close Work._what: ⛔ WHAT HAPPENS AT CONTACT RANGE — answering a committed movement, catching what is thrown, lying with your stance, or arming yourself in ki.
Close Work._note: ⚠️ All somatic. Holds the tradition's obscure and its capstone.

Traversal._what: ⛔ GETTING THROUGH, OVER, OR OUT — ground, air, built structure, or a grip meant to hold you.
Traversal._note: ⛔ CROSSES THE SECTS EVENLY: two somatic (over and out), two mason (through). The clearest case that a school is not a sect.

Material._what: ⛔ WHAT MATTER IS, WHAT IT WILL DO, AND HOW TO END IT — read it, mend it, throw it, or take it apart.
Material._note: ⚠️ Largest school. Six mason and ONE somatic — Hurled Weight, which is a person using matter rather than reading it.

Standing._what: ⛔ WHAT YOUR WORD, YOUR WORK AND YOUR PRESENCE ARE WORTH — and what happens when you reduce someone else's to what can be weighed.
Standing._note: ⛔ ALL THREE OF BODY'S SOCIAL CRAFTS, and the tradition's whole answer to a room. Reduction is the aggressive form of the same idea.

_balance._note: ⚠️ Even, and the split is legible: three schools of doing (Conditioning, Close Work, Traversal), one of knowing matter, one of standing among people.
